verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT replacement that 'runs entirely on your hardware' (jan-gh-12, jan-docs-3). Its README documents building from source, which installs dependencies, builds core components and launches the app (jan-gh-7). It runs local models and a local OpenAI-compatible API server that can be exposed to other devices on your network via 0.0.0.0 (jan-gh-4, jan-docs-6, jan-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosting, and documentation of headless/server-style deployment (e.g., Docker) beyond the desktop app.
